en.description:
Chinese Chengyu is the ultimate Apple Watch word puzzle game for learning traditional Chinese idioms!
Select and arrange 4 characters from 8 options to form authentic Chinese idioms. Get instant feedback on your answers and discover the meaning behind each chengyu.

FEATURES 
• Hundreds of traditional Chinese idioms to master
• Learn idiom meanings and pronunciation
• Bilingual support (Chinese and English)
• Intuitive touch controls for Apple Watch
• Haptic feedback for enhanced gameplay
• Quick games perfect for short breaks
Perfect for Chinese language learners, culture enthusiasts, and word puzzle fans. Challenge your knowledge of Chinese expressions anytime, anywhere with this engaging educational game.
Improve your Chinese vocabulary and cultural understanding while having fun. Each idiom includes the original characters, pinyin pronunciation, and detailed explanation.
Download Chinese Chengyu today and start your journey into the fascinating world of Chinese idioms!
en.releaseNotes: This app has been updated by Apple to prepare for watchOS 27 compatibility. No new features are included.
en.subtitle: Chinese Idioms Word Puzzle
